acceptance_criteria.statement: Code evidence reading uses bounded pages, revalidates the selected source context, and keeps each reference’s filters and diagnostics independent when sharing identical raw Git patches.

content.overview: This is a proposed outcome inferred from the existing PR code batching, request-local patch reuse, and recorded performance investigations. It records the reason for those implemented mechanisms without making the historical timings a service-level promise or accepting new product intent.
content.statement: As a Developer reviewing a large change, I can open its code evidence through bounded requests that reuse identical work within a request while checking current source context, so the review remains responsive without showing another reference’s result.
content.title: Read review evidence without repeated work
